event_attendances_self_rsvp_insert.name: event_attendances_self_rsvp_insert

event_attendances_self_rsvp_update.name: event_attendances_self_rsvp_update
event_attendances_self_rsvp_update.using: tenant_id = app.tenant_id() and user_id = app.user_id() and status in ('going','not_going')
event_attendances_self_rsvp_update.withCheck: tenant_id = app.tenant_id() and user_id = app.user_id() and status in ('going','not_going')

event_attendances_checkin_chk.name: event_attendances_checkin_chk
event_attendances_checkin_chk.value: ("event_attendances"."status" in ('checked_in','walk_in')) = ("event_attendances"."checked_in_at" is not null) and ("event_attendances"."status" in ('checked_in','walk_in')) = ("event_attendances"."checkin_via" is not null)

events_location_chk.name: events_location_chk
events_location_chk.value: ("events"."format" = 'in_person' and "events"."venue_name" is not null and "events"."address" is not null and length(btrim("events"."venue_name")) > 0 and length(btrim("events"."address")) > 0) or ("events"."format" = 'online' and "events"."venue_name" is null and "events"."address" is null)

generated.as: case when post_id is not null then 'post' else 'story' end

feed_comments_tenant_story_root_asc_idx.name: feed_comments_tenant_story_root_asc_idx
feed_comments_tenant_story_root_asc_idx.where: parent_id is null and deleted_at is null

feed_comments_parent_shape_chk.name: feed_comments_parent_shape_chk
feed_comments_parent_shape_chk.value:
(parent_id is null and parent_depth is null and parent_target_kind is null and depth = 0)
       or (parent_id is not null
           and parent_depth is not null and parent_depth = 0
           and parent_target_kind is not null and parent_target_kind = 'post'
           and depth = 1)

feed_likes_comment_kind_chk.name: feed_likes_comment_kind_chk
feed_likes_comment_kind_chk.value:
(comment_id is null and comment_target_kind is null)
       or (comment_id is not null
           and comment_target_kind is not null and comment_target_kind = 'post')

feed_post_media_kind_chk.name: feed_post_media_kind_chk
feed_post_media_kind_chk.value:
(kind = 'image' and post_media_kind = 'gallery')
       or (kind = 'video' and post_media_kind = 'video')
       or (kind = 'file' and post_media_kind in ('none','gallery','video'))
